name: Plug valve
function: A quarter-turn valve with a tapered or cylindrical plug used in treating lines to isolate a pump discharge, a manifold branch, or a bleed line.

tabs.overview: Lubricated plug valves seal with a sealant film between the plug and body; the lever or gear handle shows position. They are used where a quick, hand-operated isolation is needed and where a gate valve would be too heavy for the iron run.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the iron in 2 in. and 3 in. sizes at 10,000 or 15,000 psi; sealant injection per the OEM.
tabs.safety: A plug valve is fully open or fully closed; a partly open plug in proppant flow cuts out quickly. Never operate a plug valve on a line at pressure unless it is designed for it.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Tree saver in the wellhead; valves fully open or fully closed only; iron inspection.
Hands clear of wing nuts, handwheels, and actuator linkages during operation.
